versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "jf-store-traffic" for precise store foot traffic deployment and analysis.
- Supports full workflow: store creation, HA-5P-GM device integration, area configuration, and precise traffic algorithm setup.
- Enables querying of aggregate store traffic statistics (visitor count, entry rate, deduped visitors, batch counts, age/gender distribution).
- Generates visual HTML analysis reports (KPI overview, daily trends, customer profiles, visit batch charts).
- Includes interactive configuration tool for defining detection areas using camera snapshots.
- CLI and session-based workflow with automated parameter handling for streamlined store operations and reporting.
